seasons.title: Delivery Boys
seasons.arc_summary: The party forms as freelance couriers in Hallia, taking odd jobs that lead them to discover Ugathul infiltrators, the Embercall conspiracy, and the necromantic activities of Councilor Grayson — culminating in a harrowing escape from his underground Fane.

seasons.title: The Black and White
seasons.arc_summary: A catastrophic ambush at the Crowded Flea leaves three party members dead, sending Johnny and Benny through the Black and White void where they meet the entity Aut. Resurrected but diminished, the party hunts down Hlarf and Tywelwyn Leatherhide, uncovering a conspiracy of six Thessian gods attempting to breach the Firmament via radar dishes across Hallia.

seasons.title: The Pilgrimage
seasons.arc_summary: The rescue of Anaïs reveals the cosmic Narrative — five sibling entities including the party's patron Aut. The party attends a mysterious Pilgrimage event, competes in trials and a scavenger hunt, and trades a stolen painting to a train-heart for their first keystone — securing passage aboard a colossal walking Strider.

seasons.title: Cracks in the Firmament
seasons.arc_summary: Argyle returns from the dead as only half a man while the party investigates Teller's Run's sewers, discovering a crack in the Firmament itself where a two-mile-tall imprisoned deity looms. After uncovering a vast conspiracy funded by Grayson to shatter reality, the party bombs the research facility and triggers the Pilgrimage's departure.

seasons.title: Aboard the Strider
seasons.arc_summary: Aboard the colossal Strider, the party builds their Fane, navigates deadly faction politics, and endures the Harlequin's weekly tithe. Delving into the Undercroft, they ally with the ancient Machine God, assault the sleeping clan's hospital, and — in a desperate bid for power — destroy the Menhir, a member of the Narrative, catastrophically stranding the Strider on a dead world.

seasons.title: Stranded
seasons.arc_summary: Stranded far beyond the known map, the party rallies surviving factions, rescues a gunslinger from the Herald's thrall, hunts Anzu's corrupted sister Galzu through a surreal Fane, and discovers the alien Hesperid outpost — making first contact with castaways who reveal the true nature of the Ashen Pact and the ascension of new Thessian gods.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In the first session of a new Færrin-set one-shot (now a two-shot), four members of the Velvet Mark — Archie, Salvatore, Branson, and Combo — are tasked by Father Marone to assassinate the Spark, leader of the upstart gang Pyrelight. En route to Teller's Run, they're pulled over by Threshold Authority officers, leading to a violent car chase that ends with the cops' car flipped and destroyed. After ditching their identifiable car at Feathers' shop for a disguise, they sneak into Teller's Run and discover the Spark presiding over a burning-stage spectacle with a cheering crowd.

shows.name: A Hunt of Metal and Vine

seasons.title: The Descent into the Joker World
seasons.arc_summary: The Cagley Middle heroes slay the Terror of Cagley's shadow demon, then four high-ranking Scale operatives descend onto a shattered Joker World to investigate a mysterious structure. They fight through the fiend-held Quorum, uncover a bloodfall portal leading to the trapped divine heart Voice of Many, and wage a desperate defense to free it and escape.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In a one-shot set months before the main campaign, three Undercroft workers — Barlow Crane, Grant FireEye, and Gage the Cunning — investigate sabotage aboard the massive moving Strider city of Iomenei. Tracking an elven suspect named Gerhardt into a long-abandoned forsaken sector, they discover an insectoid infestation centered on a dormant engine heart cathedral and must slay a massive Swarm Hive Mother. Though they halt the infestation, the true saboteur remains at large.

seasons.title: The Sedecium Fire Team
seasons.arc_summary: A trio of Sedecium agents — Old Man Scrazzy, Lieutenant Foral, and Ozzie — undertake perilous missions across the slip and beyond, first investigating a derelict orbital observatory to uncover a Thessian conspiracy, then raiding a dead god's essence before it's devoured. Across both operations they prove themselves as Sedecium's most capable fire team.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: A D&D 5e one-shot set on the Finnegan Ring caravan route. Three caravan members — Mango the elven ranger, Doug Donahue the gnome rogue, and Egan the orc druid — are transported along with flautist Erin Proudcloak to a fey swampland by a mysterious mist. There, the fey creature Larunan forces them to fight for his amusement in an arena battle full of chaotic magical effects. The party survives and is returned to the caravan.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: When a goblin intern at Bisney & Dixar Animated Studios connects a new arcane intelligence to the studio's databases, the AI overloads and casts a spell that engulfs Los Diablos in a blackout and creates a 'movie' on the island of Afro-China. Three Disney villains — Hades, Fulton (Gaston's legally distinct cousin), and Runway Brian (a forgotten Disney short mouse) — are chosen by a mandrill statue of Zeus to recover an enchanted mirror stolen by Maui, now hidden in an Elephant Graveyard of Wonders. After surviving a wildebeest stampede, solving the Cave of Wonders' riddle, defeating the hybrid genie Jaskar (Jafar-Scar fusion), and wishing themselves past a whole skipped sequence to the final soundstage, the trio battles the Legally Distinct Nostalgia Hydra — a five-headed amalgamation of iconic Disney characters that undergoes a terrifying live-action reboot mid-fight. They slay it, seize the mirror, and dive through it into the real world.
